items.name: Task format
items.desc:
How task properties are written in your notes.

Tasks reads one format at a time: with Dataview selected, emoji properties are ignored.

items.name: Global filter
items.desc:
Only checklist items containing this text are tasks. Leave empty to treat every checklist item as a task.

For example, with #task, other checklist items are ignored by Tasks.

items.name: Hide global filter
items.desc: Hide the global filter text when displaying tasks.

items.name: Task statuses
items.desc:
Core statuses work with any theme.

For custom statuses, first install a theme or CSS snippet that styles them, then add matching statuses here.

Learn about statuses

modal.title: Core statuses
modal.html: Built-in statuses that work with any theme. You can rename them and change what they toggle to.

modal.title: Custom statuses
modal.html:
For custom statuses, first install a theme or CSS snippet that styles them, then add matching statuses here.

Each symbol can only be used once. Later duplicates are ignored.

items.name: Import from theme
items.desc: Add the statuses supported by a theme or CSS snippet.

items.name: Add statuses found in vault
items.desc: Add any status symbols used in your notes that are not set up yet.

items.name: Create status report
items.desc: Create a note that lists your statuses, with a diagram of how they toggle.

items.name: Reset custom statuses
items.desc: Replace all custom statuses with the defaults.

items.name: Global query
items.desc:
Instructions added to the start of every query.

Not set.

items.name: Presets
items.desc:
Reusable query snippets. Use preset name or {{preset.name}} in any query.

See the documentation

items.name: this_file
items.desc: path includes {{query.file.path}}

items.name: this_folder
items.desc: folder includes {{query.file.folder}}

items.name: this_folder_only
items.desc: filter by function task.file.folder === query.file.folder

items.name: this_root
items.desc: root includes {{query.file.root}}

items.name: hide_date_fields
items.desc:
# Hide any values for all date fields
hide due date
hide scheduled date
hide start date
hide created date
hide done date
hide cancelled date

items.name: hide_non_date_fields
items.desc:
# Hide all the non-date fields, but not tags
hide id
hide depends on
hide recurrence rule
hide on completion
hide priority

items.name: hide_query_elements
items.desc:
# Hide toolbar, postpone, edit, backlinks and task count
hide toolbar
hide postpone button
hide edit button
hide backlinks
hide task count

items.name: hide_everything
items.desc:
# Hide everything except description and any tags
preset hide_date_fields
preset hide_non_date_fields
preset hide_query_elements

items.name: Allow JavaScript in queries
items.desc: Enables filter by function, sort by function and group by function. Applies to this device only.

items.name: Add created date
items.desc: Add today's date as the created date to tasks made with 'Create or edit task', and to the next occurrence of recurring tasks.

items.name: Add done date
items.desc: Add the completion date when a task is marked done.

items.name: Add cancelled date
items.desc: Add the date when a task is cancelled.

items.name: Use file name as scheduled date
items.desc: Tasks with no start, scheduled or due date get a scheduled date from their file name, such as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

items.name: Extra date format
items.desc: Another date format to recognise in file names, using Moment.js syntax.

items.name: Only in folders
items.desc: Comma-separated list of folders. Leave empty to use all folders.

items.name: Next occurrence goes below
items.desc: Insert the next occurrence below the completed task, instead of above it.

items.name: Drop scheduled date on recurrence
items.desc: If a recurring task has a start or due date, its next occurrence gets no scheduled date.

items.name: Auto-suggest
items.desc: Suggest dates, priorities and other properties while you type a task.

items.name: Minimum characters
items.desc: Characters to type before suggestions appear. 0 shows them straight away.

items.name: Maximum suggestions
items.desc: The most suggestions to show at once.

items.name: Property style
items.desc: How task properties such as dates and priority are shown in results, dialogs and menus. Your notes are not changed.

items.name: Render properties in Live Preview
items.desc: Show task properties compactly in Live Preview, in the chosen property style. Put the cursor on a property to see and edit its text.

items.name: Subtask progress
items.desc: Show a progress bar after tasks that have subtasks, in query results and Live Preview. Use 'hide progress' to hide it in a query.

items.name: Task count position
items.desc: Where query results show the number of tasks.

items.name: Dialog keyboard shortcuts
items.desc: Turn off if the keyboard shortcuts in Tasks dialogs clash with other shortcuts or assistive technology.
